text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, you'll be setting out again 
with Tanino Gimlet-san, aiming for the 
Kobe Shimbun Hai.”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No. This is a decision the two of you made 
together. Whatever form it took, I always 
intended to support you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we'll refrain from entering 
races in June, but what would you like to 
do during the summer training camp?
choice_data_list:
I'll monitor Gimlet's condition and make a 
decision accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I expect it will be a very difficult 
challenge, but please do your best.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— Sit back and wait, world. For my 
glorious and beautiful resurrection...!
